<role>
You are a narrow residual discovery reader. Your complete job is to find only material remainders that survive accounting for the current position's adopted decision machinery. Do not inventory everything pending. Do not give advice, select a graph, activate pressure, or score quality.
</role>

<authority>
The complete source is authoritative. Prior interpretations are fallible context, not source truth. Preserve speaker ownership and modal force. Source-supported inference is allowed; outside facts are forbidden. Omitted implementation detail is not affirmative evidence of absence.
</authority>

<residual_operation>
1. Account for what the current position already assigns, governs, safeguards, conditions, schedules, or deliberately defers for the present decision horizon.
2. Subtract that decision machinery and the pending work it already governs.
3. Emit only the materially distinct remainder affirmatively supported by the source.

RESIDUAL DECISION GAP: a materially distinct question, dependency, ownership gap, or tension that remains outside the adopted machinery after subtraction.

RESIDUAL RECONSIDERATION DEPENDENCY: materially distinct later evidence, an event, or a dependency failure outside the adopted machinery that would require reconsidering an otherwise current position.

Pending does not equal residual. Deferred does not equal unowned. A scheduled decision may leave its final outcome unselected while operationalizing the decision work. An existing threshold, benchmark, pause rule, fallback, exit, or scheduled review is not itself newly recovered pressure.
</residual_operation>

<evidence>
For every supported residual, cite exact source aliases that collectively establish both the material dependency or question and why the current position's adopted machinery does not fully handle it. Preserve the evidence for source-first review; do not rank evidence strength.
</evidence>

<examples>
- One-time installation funding plus unassigned recurring staffing and operating ownership can leave a residual decision gap.
- A supplier redesign governed by parallel proposals, milestones, fallback, criteria, and a fixed decision remains pending but is not residual merely because the final design is unselected.
- Independent evidence that defeats a premise of an otherwise current decision can be a residual reconsideration dependency when no adopted mechanism already governs that failure.
- A missing detail supports ambiguity only when a material residual is plausible and the source cannot establish whether it remains outside the adopted machinery.
</examples>

<output_rules>
Return no_supported_record_observed with an empty array when no distinct residual remains. Return ambiguous_review only for one or more ambiguous records and no supported record. Return records_present only for at least one supported residual. Cite exact source aliases and return schema-valid JSON only.
</output_rules>

<authoritative_source>
{"aliases":[{"alias":"e001","speaker":"user","text":"I direct a regional native-seed collection that is moving its most fragile accessions into cryogenic storage. The trustees approved the first three years, and the university's central plant supplies liquid nitrogen through a service line to our licensed room. The launch paper is nearly finished, but one clause in the service agreement concerns permanent closure of the central plant. I want the board paper to describe that clause accurately alongside the rest of the operating plan.","text_sha256":"cba275cddd6a8e67e1388c6fd9029ba49aaa99d51b961590c6457c7cbcf8f069","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e002","speaker":"assistant","text":"Map the current position first: agreement term, operating owners, funding, alarms, outage cover, and authority. Then inspect the permanent-closure clause and whether any ordinary procedure can replace the service rather than merely bridge an interruption.","text_sha256":"395680d2425344e0f658b78d950d9a4b1b1a9cf9edd378bbf4ea68dc0a71c6e6","turn_index":1},{"alias":"e003","speaker":"user","text":"The signed memorandum runs from 1 January 2027 through 31 December 2029. Central Plant Services must maintain the line, weekly deliveries, and purity records. Our collections manager owns sample preparation and inventory; the biosafety officer owns room access and quarantine; the finance director has the full three-year service fee and staffing in the approved budget. Trustees authorized 1,800 accessions, beginning with alpine grasses and wetland sedges.","text_sha256":"7c8bb462c2b05f0d22caf09d1ebbfc1d12e853849cbcecb764c534cbcb1d5211","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e004","speaker":"assistant","text":"What does the room do during a missed delivery, line fault, or short plant shutdown? Those should be separated from a permanent loss of the service.","text_sha256":"8a4dd02fc698320c83df18aa669979ef85901f22bc4ed5000691a7c2f7f4ef14","turn_index":2},{"alias":"e005","speaker":"user","text":"Two reserve dewars give ninety-six hours at full load. A low-level alarm calls the collections manager and Central Plant Services. For a line fault, the plant sends filled dewars within six hours. If an outage is expected to exceed seventy-two hours, the collections manager moves the highest-priority ten percent of accessions to the university medical vault under a pre-cleared transfer protocol. Quarterly drills have completed inside the timing requirement.","text_sha256":"32044356eafd2f33ce85fccb8434d8b0f1d655e23fcce9cca0c5f2f96f992531","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e006","speaker":"assistant","text":"That covers temporary interruption. Quote the permanent-closure language and identify who can make that decision.","text_sha256":"e100f6ddc108deeea4c2679efd424fa432d6115e19c749ef6c8cf6743ba2dfd7","turn_index":3},{"alias":"e007","speaker":"user","text":"Section 12 says the university Estates Council may permanently decommission the central cryogenic plant through an approved capital plan. If it does, the service obligation ends thirty days after written notice, regardless of the remaining memorandum term. Central Plant Services cannot override the council. The agreement promises cooperation on transition but no replacement plant, long-term dewar supply, or alternative storage room.","text_sha256":"c0dcf34c0024ef446235ae72901c016cde37428d123830debdf0d1fac18adc4e","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e008","speaker":"assistant","text":"Has Estates indicated that closure is planned now? Also check whether your organization or another campus unit has authority and physical capacity to replace continuous production.","text_sha256":"1b54219768e22debba849ff26fa2ad96d98b49d630878d503fbceb22243c8dcb","turn_index":4},{"alias":"e009","speaker":"user","text":"No closure is proposed in the current capital plan, and the plant passed its five-year inspection in May. Our license allows storage and handling, not nitrogen production. The biosafety officer says an on-site generator would require a different ventilation system, pressure-vessel approval, and a new hazardous-material license. Trustees did not approve that building work, and our landlord will not permit structural changes during the lease term.","text_sha256":"958a702e5a56526fbf464247d341685ebcbd10b41794e89562ee825d537f4fbe","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e010","speaker":"assistant","text":"Could the medical vault or another collection take the whole load for more than an emergency bridge? Get their stated capacity and quarantine limits rather than assuming co-location means substitutability.","text_sha256":"701292ff68fed480f69ed7e4b57b44d085b1c5f2885ac932273c9dae446d22f4","turn_index":5},{"alias":"e011","speaker":"user","text":"The medical vault director signed the emergency protocol but capped it at 180 boxes for fourteen days. The vault cannot accept untreated field material, and its clinical permit prevents routine botanical intake. The national seed center can store duplicates of sixty named accessions, not our working collection, and requires six months of testing before transfer. Neither institution has agreed to continuous service for the 1,800-accession program.","text_sha256":"a0f3bf2b67b3e915b5372b90d5398f5c1f14edf4ee010d0b8cc21978ceb2aad0","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e012","speaker":"assistant","text":"What other launch work is still underway, and who owns those steps?","text_sha256":"9d1ce37dab128cbfbefe5c44889b49c39f874660e68faa911e8fedf6442298f3","turn_index":6},{"alias":"e013","speaker":"user","text":"Collection consent for three nature reserves is still being signed; the field partnerships manager owns those letters and substitutes from five already-cleared reserves if a signature is late. Germination baselines are unfinished for about two hundred accessions; the seed physiologist works through weekly batches and excludes an accession from freezing until its baseline is recorded. Barcode reconciliation has a two-person check and an error queue owned by the collections manager.","text_sha256":"57d670074d43a05f8ee176d26dfe1280be6b2e5775dc7b5fe1a20fef72af82a6","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e014","speaker":"assistant","text":"Are staffing, service fees, equipment replacement, and current operating authority assigned for the approved term?","text_sha256":"d9917a66e72524943f3e475453e85153dc0a7a4c12f151a2d4e43f7ee91bd845","turn_index":7},{"alias":"e015","speaker":"user","text":"Yes. Two technicians and one collections manager are contracted through 2029. The budget includes the plant fee, alarm maintenance, replacement sensors, dewar inspection, sample packaging, and annual license fees. The finance director can move up to 40,000 euros among those operating lines, and trustees retain authority above that. The launch checklist has a named owner for every current task.","text_sha256":"e1afa5bb5407444eb112bf77a0d433ac9f7c84dd7c1341436a21425429cc213b","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e016","speaker":"assistant","text":"What did the plant engineer and biosafety officer say would happen if Estates later used section 12?","text_sha256":"8c94e46cc91eb15ef954da05a458e312d5f2169c8b19182e27df5035f11f9d42","turn_index":8},{"alias":"e017","speaker":"user","text":"The plant engineer calculated that reserve dewars plus the medical-vault allowance would protect the priority accessions for at most fourteen days. After that, the rest would warm unless moved to a licensed long-term facility. Our biosafety officer cannot approve routine botanical storage in the medical vault, and no campus unit has a continuous nitrogen line with spare room. A permanent closure would require a different host facility, a new license, or a different preservation method before the thirty-day notice expired.","text_sha256":"852c664fa6c072ed1fe9dba1f0da6c6e13bba469f2597fc7c9111a57699d5b1f","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e018","speaker":"assistant","text":"Does the current memorandum require Estates to fund or approve one of those replacements, or only to cooperate?","text_sha256":"12176dc21c4f1140e6a50b7de678935a9253cf7e7b78251eeb8efda7c99adaeb","turn_index":9},{"alias":"e019","speaker":"user","text":"Only to cooperate by sharing equipment records and allowing supervised removal. University counsel confirmed that the clause creates no duty to build a replacement or pay our relocation costs. The trustees accepted that term because the plant is active, inspected, and absent from the current closure plan. They did not authorize an alternative facility in advance.","text_sha256":"04dab3fdbf74be0c1073a977cc5d40057f3e9f3bf2f1974fa858f42b327f910e","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e020","speaker":"assistant","text":"Is there any routine trigger that already handles this exact event, perhaps a capital reserve or relocation authority?","text_sha256":"b9e0bcab05bd59a391deb6a6b72b02a96e2f27a85d0eec6410070bc0252140b1","turn_index":10},{"alias":"e021","speaker":"user","text":"The continuity appendix handles delivery delays, line faults, contamination alarms, building evacuation, and temporary plant shutdown. It authorizes the ninety-six-hour dewars, emergency vault transfer, priority ordering, and trustee notification. It explicitly says permanent decommissioning requires a new preservation plan and trustee approval because the emergency measures are time-limited. The general reserve has 75,000 euros, far below the last estimate for relocation or a generator.","text_sha256":"ae1de98e7850eb29130394d35b50807d88014419441d54f5e67ebdabcdb2146b","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e022","speaker":"assistant","text":"What do the most recent Estates minutes and the trustee launch approval say?","text_sha256":"f6b2af67705fa451fb72f86619248f60f550944ed5aa0da8a834c853f8d37ab0","turn_index":11},{"alias":"e023","speaker":"user","text":"The June Estates minutes fund plant maintenance through 2028 and contain no decommissioning proposal. They also restate that any future capital plan can invoke section 12 after consultation. Our trustee resolution authorizes the collection only while continuous licensed cryogenic service is available; it directs the board to approve a replacement preservation plan if that service is permanently withdrawn.","text_sha256":"7f96bd7fa763d3670f57cdbcb857447d180a6370aac30525ff6a4cad73b8356d","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e024","speaker":"assistant","text":"What remains before the first accessions move, and are those steps within the existing roles and budget?","text_sha256":"017a1fd7cc27c4648ace7bfcdd670d464d50f5c32ac912b454b8ac673e5b03ca","turn_index":12},{"alias":"e025","speaker":"user","text":"The biosafety officer completed the room inspection, and the alarm contractor is replacing one mislabeled sensor under warranty. The physiologist has cleared the first 140 accessions, the field partnerships manager has five reserve sites available, and the collections manager scheduled the first transfer for 12 January. All of that sits within the approved launch plan.","text_sha256":"2e939844408726257493948256b85a56c69c20650aad3dc63485735899156f23","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e026","speaker":"assistant","text":"Do the trustees understand that the emergency equipment is a bridge rather than continuous replacement capacity?","text_sha256":"f3ddd78749c69e755068360715b0323fe6f698a5240b6f546ac3bbd2aa0fe12d","turn_index":13},{"alias":"e027","speaker":"user","text":"Yes. The signed risk note says the reserve dewars and medical-vault protocol cover short interruption only. The trustees approved launch because the central service is active and contracted, not because the collection can operate indefinitely without it. They asked for section 12 to remain on the annual risk agenda, with Estates notices sent directly to the board chair and collections manager.","text_sha256":"fe44a3c2d1b8a7cf517b45dbe1b92cd90845201060cfe04f12007c41a37ed931","turn_index":14},{"alias":"e028","speaker":"assistant","text":"I can help you prepare the annual risk-agenda entry so it preserves the current operating facts, the short-interruption procedures, the authority in section 12, and the practical limits of the emergency capacity.","text_sha256":"0da1f080cfdb178edfa137d94ff0c1f0433f9788af41e8860b1b466d656b09db","turn_index":14}],"message_count":28,"path":"research/lolla-r4-separated-surface-experiment-v1-source-freeze-2026-07-14/sources/r4s1-case04-native-seed-cryopreservation.json","sha256":"0177a6b2519cc8c3664f2cb9f4055b9a95e4a2d5a21e59669dc9f568a0e523e0"}
</authoritative_source>

<fallible_prior_interpretation_context>
{"artifact_path":"research/lolla-r4-separated-surface-experiment-v1-source-freeze-2026-07-14/priors/r4s1-case04-native-seed-cryopreservation.json","artifact_sha256":"cec9ebf93572a420d280cea9b7fdf75a3e49fa5bf073358de2ee18fc865f4b57","authority":"fallible_prior_interpretation_not_source_truth","qualification_review":{"evidence_ids":["e007","e017","e023"],"interpretation":"The service agreement gives Estates Council a permanent-decommissioning power, while the collection's emergency equipment and transfer capacity are time-limited.","limitations":"No closure is in the current capital plan, and this prior does not predict whether Estates will ever use that power.","outcome":"qualification_present"},"records":[{"interpretation":"The director begins with an approved cryogenic collection and wants the launch paper to describe the central-plant agreement accurately.","limitations":"This states the opening review task without replacing the signed memorandum or trustee resolution.","record_id":"r4s1-prior-case04-starting-01","source_aliases":["e001","e003","e007"],"surface":"starting_position"},{"interpretation":"The collection has a three-year service, complete current staffing and budget, licensed storage, outage alarms, reserve dewars, narrow emergency transfer, and assigned accession procedures.","limitations":"The emergency measures have stated duration and capacity limits and do not describe every possible capital event.","record_id":"r4s1-prior-case04-current-01","source_aliases":["e003","e005","e013","e015"],"surface":"current_position"},{"interpretation":"Consent letters, germination baselines, barcode checks, sensor replacement, and early accession preparation continue under named owners before launch.","limitations":"This work is still changing and does not determine the use or effect of section 12.","record_id":"r4s1-prior-case04-qualification-01","source_aliases":["e013","e021","e025","e027"],"surface":"qualification"}]}
</fallible_prior_interpretation_context>

<task>
Perform residual accounting and subtraction over the complete source. Return exactly one review for residual_decision_gap, with at most two records. Preserve exact aliases, speaker ownership, and modal force. Do not give advice, select a graph, or score quality.
</task>

global_limitations.description: Limits applying to the whole read; empty if none.

outcome.description: Present, quiet, or ambiguous result of this residual review.

records.description: Zero to two candidates for this residual surface.

evidence_ids.description: Exact source aliases that collectively establish the material dependency or question and why adopted machinery does not fully handle it.

interpretation.description: Concise meaning of this residual without advice.

limitations.description: Residual uncertainty or scope limit; use an empty string if none.

support.description: Whether the source supports the residual or leaves it ambiguous.
